subject: Invoice & payment collection: invoice creation flow vs portal billing ownership
messages:
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme-corp.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: billing@acme-corp.com
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO 8471 — invoice delivery & who we should expect it from

Hi Mina,

We just received PO 8471 for the Redwood Dedicated pilot and my AP team needs to confirm how invoices will be generated and where they will arrive. A few quick questions: 

- Will Redwood issue an invoice from the hosted billing system (PDF) attached to an email, or will invoices be generated and pulled from your customer portal as XML/EDI?
- Who should be set as the billing contact on your side (email and copy-to)? Our payment terms are net 30 and we need invoices sent to billing@acme-corp.com and optionally to our procurement contact (procure@acme-corp.com).
- Do you support attaching the original PO number in both the filename and the invoice metadata for automatic AP ingestion?

I've attached PO_8471 for reference. If you prefer a short call to align, I can send a 15-min slot.

Thanks,
Sarah Lim
Senior AP Specialist, Acme Corp

Attachment: Acme_PO_8471.pdf (PDF, 120KB)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 25 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 8471 — invoice delivery & who we should expect it from

Hi Sarah,

Thanks for sending — received. Short answers up front and then options based on your AP capabilities: 

1) Invoice generation: by default our hosted billing will generate a PDF invoice and email it to the billing contact. We also provide an exportable XML/CSV from the customer portal for customers who ingest invoices electronically.

2) Billing contact: happy to set billing@acme-corp.com as the primary delivery address and copy procure@acme-corp.com. If you want the invoice to come from a specific vendor email (e.g., invoices@redwood.com) we can do that.

3) PO metadata: yes — we can embed PO numbers in the invoice filename (Invoice-ACME-8471.pdf) and in an invoice-level metadata field included in the XML.

If Acme prefers portal ingestion we will:
- Turn on ‘AP export’ for your account (weekly or on-demand)
- Provide an SFTP drop or S3-compatible endpoint for automated pulls (we support both)
- Include configurable filename patterns and XML schema mapping (attach an example schema if needed)

If email is easier, we'll send PDFs to billing@acme-corp.com with the PO in the subject and filename. Which method does your AP team prefer? If you want, I can loop in our billing ops lead to set up mapping.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference

---
Forwarded attachment: Acme_PO_8471.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 26 May 2027 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: PO 8471 — invoice delivery & who we should expect it from

Mina / Vivek — looping you in for decisioning. Quick notes below: 

- Acme is large AP team; they asked both for email delivery and a portal-based export. Most enterprise customers want the SFTP/XML route for system-to-system posting.
- We should offer SFTP + weekly XML export, with an email copy to billing@acme-corp.com to satisfy small teams. That reduces manual follow-up and avoids PDF parsing issues.

Questions for you, Vivek: below are our constraints for SFTP setup and retention for invoices:

1) Can we provision a dedicated SFTP path for Acme under the dedicated account pool and rotate keys quarterly?
2) What SLA do we commit to for the AP export (availability / delay)?

Mina: once we have the SFTP endpoint and template, can your team create a sample XML per Acme's schema and a test file that includes their PO number? Also, include filename pattern that explicitly contains the PO and invoice id.

Proposed owner: Billing Ops (Mina) to own the email fallback; Platform/Onboarding (Marissa) to coordinate SFTP onboarding; Infra (Vivek) to provision endpoint.

Let me know if you want me to offer a 30-minute onboarding call with Acme's AP + our billing ops.

-Marissa
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@acme-corp.com>, Acme Corp AP <billing@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: PO 8471 — invoice delivery & who we should expect it from

Hi Sarah — following up with our agreed path. Thanks for the quick sync earlier today. Summary and next steps: 

Summary decisions:
- Primary delivery: SFTP export (weekly) with invoice XML files that include PO number in both the filename and XML metadata.
- Email fallback: PDFs will be emailed to billing@acme-corp.com the same day the XML is generated.
- Endpoint: we will provision an SFTP host (sftp.redwood-secure.com) and provide SSH key-based access. Keys will rotate quarterly; we will provide a key rotation schedule.
- Filename pattern: Invoice-ACME-8471-{{invoice_id}}.xml (and corresponding PDF Invoice-ACME-8471-{{invoice_id}}.pdf).
- Retention: exports retained for 180 days; archived copies retained for 2 years per our standard enterprise retention policy. If you require longer retention we can discuss an extended retention add-on.

Action items: 
1) Acme: confirm billing@acme-corp.com is the primary ingest address and send the contact for your SFTP admin (name + public key) to onboarding@redwood.com.
2) Redwood (Mina): send sample XML + mapping doc and a sample PDF by EOD 31 May (attached).
3) Redwood (Vivek): provision the SFTP path and share host + path + user by 31 May.

Attachments included: Invoice_template_example.xlsx (sample XML mapping), Acme_PO_8471.pdf (original PO).

If that works, I'll mark the onboarding task complete and we can schedule the test transfer.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Regards,
Mina Haddad
Billing Operations | Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0193

Attachments: Invoice_template_example.xlsx (XLSX, 28KB); Acme_PO_8471.pdf (PDF, 120KB)
